text:
Lia (partnerships): Heads up — prep meeting for SI marketplace + HW partner integration next Wed 11am PT. Need to align checklist, lab access, and the joint announcement cadence. Who can take the lead on cert steps?
Samir (solutions): I can own the technical cert checklist. Can we split hardware validation vs listing QA?
Jess (pmkt): I'll handle the announcement draft and co-marketing approvals. Need ETA on when we can confirm GA-ready assets.
Maria (p-success): I'll coordinate trainer access for SIs and schedule the certification cohort. Lab seats are limited — how many breaks needed?
Tom (eng): For the hardware side, we'll need partner images + perf reports. ETA on test vectors from SI? Also need service account for automated tests.
Lia (partnerships): Great. Samir — please create the cert checklist doc and include these sections: listing config, perf targets, functional tests, security review. Put it in the shared drive and link here.
Samir (solutions): Created initial draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/si-cert-checklist (please review). Main open items: KV cache behavior under batching, quantization compat on our serving runtime.
Jess (pmkt): Thanks. For the announcement timeline: propose internal freeze by Thu two weeks before public launch. We'll need logo, screenshots, short quote from the SI and hardware partner.
Maria (p-success): On training — propose two cohorts: one live workshop (2hr) + self-serve lab. Suggest target: 12 SI engineers per cohort. Can we allocate 2 GPU nodes for the hands-on lab?
Tom (eng): I can provision 2 GPU nodes in the staging cluster for the workshop window. Need service account name and IP allowlist. Add this snippet to the checklist:
```
# infra reqs
service_account: si-training@redwood-infra
allowlist_ips:
- 34.212.33.10/32
- 34.212.33.11/32
```
Samir (solutions): Noted. I'll add infra reqs and automated perf harness steps. Also adding a small test harness script to reproduce latency numbers.
Lia (partnerships): For marketplace listing: productization lead needs a bundle with: SKU, pricing guidance, support matrix, and a 1-pager 'what's included'. Samir — can you capture the runtime variant options we recommend (quantized, fp16, etc.)?
Samir (solutions): Yep — recommended variants: fp16 (low-latency), int8-q (cost-opt), fallback small-model for outage. I'll include SLO guidance per variant.
Jess (pmkt): Looping legal — we have to clear the joint press pipeline. @partners-bot can we create a PRD task and route to legal/brand? :pray:
partners-bot: Created task #4521 and notified legal.brand@redwood.com.
Maria (p-success): One more ops question: will SIs get sandbox billing credits for the lab? That helps adoption during cert.
Lia (partnerships): Yes — recommend 2000 credits per SI for the cohort. Finance ok'd that. I'll put a short playbook entry for credits + expiry.
Samir (solutions): I'll schedule a dry-run workshop next Tue 9am PT. Need at least 2 volunteers to play the SI role to run through the lab flow.
Jess (pmkt): I'll join the dry-run and take screenshots. Also drafting the joint announcement copy — will share a first pass by EOD Friday.
Tom (eng): I'll prepare the infra and a health-check dashboard for the workshop routes.
Lia (partnerships): Awesome. To summarize action items: Samir = cert checklist + test harness; Tom = infra + allowlist + nodes; Maria = manage cohorts + credits; Jess = announcement + legal loop; Lia = playbook and partner comms.
Samir (solutions): I'll update the checklist today and ping for review.
Maria (p-success): Reserving cohort slots — sending calendar invites after Samir confirms lab content.
Jess (pmkt): Added a simple co-marketing checklist to the doc for approvals.
Lia (partnerships): Thanks team. If no blockers, we'll lock the meeting invite and send the agenda by EOD. :rocket: 
Samir (solutions): No blockers from me.
Tom (eng): All set on my side.
partners-bot: Reminder — meeting created: "SI marketplace + HW integration prep" Wed 11am PT (calendar link sent).
